question: How does the GRC Assessment Framework™ (“OCEG Burgundy Book”) align with the GRC Capability Model™ (“OCEG Red Book”)? A. It does not consider the GRC Capability Model™ in its assessment approach. B. It focuses solely on financial audits rather than comprehensive GRC assessments. C.
